The day will start with partly cloudy skies, gradually giving way to overcast conditions as the low-pressure system intensifies. Temperatures will rise to a high of 29°C, while the low will dip to 22°C. The humidity levels will be elevated, ranging from 80% to 90% throughout the day, making the air feel warm and muggy. In areas such as Maitama and Garki, the elevated humidity levels will be more pronounced due to the urban heat island effect.
The wind direction will shift from northwest to southeast as the day progresses, leading to an increase in moisture flux into the region. This will contribute to the development of thunderstorms in the late afternoon and early evening hours. The rainfall accumulation is expected to range from 10mm to 20mm, with some areas potentially experiencing higher amounts. The Aso Rock area, being one of the higher elevations in the city, may experience more intense rainfall due to the orographic enhancement of precipitation. The evening hours will see a gradual decrease in precipitation, with partly cloudy skies returning by nightfall. The temperature will remain relatively steady, ranging from 22°C to 24°C, while the humidity levels will remain elevated.
